buildings.name: Founders Hall
buildings.blurb: One multi-purpose hall, the first thing on the land and the last thing anyone will agree to demolish.

buildings.name: Academic Hall
buildings.blurb: A teaching hall in the founding style. Schools are founded in one of these.

buildings.name: Library
buildings.blurb: Top-lit reading rooms behind a colonnade. The building a campus puts its name on.

buildings.name: Laboratory
buildings.blurb: Low, flat, and crowded with rooftop plant. Research runs here.

buildings.name: Residence Hall
buildings.blurb: A four-storey hall of ranked windows under one long roof.

buildings.name: Dining Hall
buildings.blurb: A refectory. Somewhere near the residence halls is where it wants to be.

buildings.name: Student Center
buildings.blurb: The union: clubs, lounges, and the noticeboard nobody reads.

buildings.name: Health Center
buildings.blurb: Counselling and a clinic. White panel, because that is what a clinic is.

buildings.name: Recreation Center
buildings.blurb: A clear-span hall lit from a band under the eaves. Engineering, not architecture.

buildings.name: Playing Field
buildings.blurb: A marked pitch on open ground. The stadium comes later, if it comes at all.

buildings.name: Administration
buildings.blurb: Offices. It will need a bigger one. It will always need a bigger one.
